title: Trump’s Whirlwind Asia Trip Begins in the Philippines
summary_full: President Trump’s 48-hour trip started with a meeting with Southeast Asian leaders in Manila. He will later meet Xi Jinping of China and Vladimir Putin of Russia in Shenzhen, a Chinese economic hub.
